featured_text: Don't poke the bear... or underestimate her! The cry of battle runs so deep in her bones that it's released a spirited beast capable of unbearable things. Hero Berserker is bearly holding it together!

Whirl power! Hero Valkyrie has gone round and round the arena| getting whipped into shapre and chopping down troops with an axe that won't quit. Now| she's ready for her final test at the gates of Valkhalla.
These guys throw absolute ragers! Every few seconds| Evolved Elite Barbarians can hurl rage-tipped spears to distant enemies that create an enraging path for allies.
Need your weapons sharpened? You've come to the right place. Rune Giant enchants troops closest to her| having them deal bonus damage every third attack. Only two troops can be enchanted at once.
A wandering warrior with nowhere to be and no one he can't defeat. Ronin parries one melee attack every few seconds| reflecting even more damage than he blocked. 1v1 him| we triple hog dare you!
